name: What is the difference between painting doors with a brush and rolling/spraying?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between painting doors with a brush and rolling/spraying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each method of painting doors offers different results and advantages. Brushing allows for precise control and is good for intricate details, but can leave brush marks. Rolling provides a smoother, more even finish over flat surfaces and is quicker than brushing for larger areas. Spraying offers the smoothest, most professional-looking finish with no brush or roller marks, and is the fastest method, but requires more preparation to protect surrounding areas and can be more complex for DIYers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Brushing offers control, rolling provides a smoother finish, and spraying gives the most professional, even look.
